updates.text: Promoted from the practice squad on September 8 for safety and coverage-unit depth after Lowery went to reserve/injured, the packet's proposed promotion, on a new three-year minimum contract. He practiced in full Wednesday through Friday in the safety reserve work behind Rambo, Trawick and Prosinski and on the two full-speed coverage fits Wednesday and the changed-picture retest Friday, with nothing charged to him on the recorded reps. Active for Week 2 by Stone's chart; a coverage-unit job is Westhoff's assignment on the day, not a promise.
updates.source: Source: [September 8 transactions](career/2014/Team_Operations/Team/Roster/transactions_2014-09-08.md) and the [Week 2 record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_02/output.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Sixteen kicking-game snaps and no defensive snap, with the coverage tackle on Royal's 13-yard punt return at 11:07 of the fourth quarter. A minor lower-extremity injury was logged at 9:58 of the fourth quarter at the end of San Diego's next possession; he was not removed: out, projected return September 29, reassessment September 29 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/adrian_phillips_2014-09-28.md)). No role change follows.
updates.source: Source: [Week 4 game record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_04/output.md) and its public receipt. This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Cleared Monday, September 29, his projected date, at the reassessment his instruction named, and full in every session of the Pittsburgh week. Under Stone's packet he dresses as the next safety and a kicking-game reserve, and Westhoff reconciled his kicking jobs in the Friday period once the medical decision was known. Nothing charged to him on the recorded reps.
